data.name: Sabeela
data.gender_notes: Sabeela is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who is as gentle and caring as the breeze, and as stable and reliable as the sky. A beacon of comfort and ease for those around her. The name Sabeela carries the meaning “Lady of the sky” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Sabeela usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the journey towards spiritual enlightenment, representing the ease and comfort one finds in their faith.
data.etymology: Sabeela belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady of the sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabeela total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_pashto.name: سبيله
